about.title: What is Hawalaty?
about.text: Hawalaty is your point-of-sale and order management system for بيت التميس. Record every order as a transfer — paid in cash or through a bank/wallet — manage your menu and its categories, track full order history, export professional reports, and keep your banks and wallets up to date, all in one bilingual, dark-mode-ready workspace.

features.dashboard: Your daily snapshot: available balance, quick actions, scheduled items and recent transactions at a glance.
features.transfers: Send a standalone transfer with a fee breakdown and confirmation summary.
features.history: The full archive of past orders with filters by status, type and time range.
features.banks: Manage the banks and wallets used for payments and giving change back to customers.
features.menu: Manage your menu items, prices and availability, organized by category.
features.reports: Generate and export a professional PDF report with totals and averages.
features.settings: Your profile, security, notifications, and the Constants tab for managing menu categories.

newOrder.q: How do I record a new order?
newOrder.a: Click "New Transfer" from the sidebar or the Send quick action on the Dashboard, add items from the menu, then choose whether the customer paid in cash or through a bank/wallet.

addCategory.q: How do I add a new menu category?
addCategory.a: Go to Settings → Constants, type the new category name and click Add. It appears immediately in the Menu page's filters and in the item form.

exportReport.q: How do I export a report?
exportReport.a: Open the Reports page and click "Export PDF" — the report is generated from your transfer history, ready to save or print.

language.q: How do I switch language or dark mode?
language.a: Use the language toggle (English / العربية) and the sun/moon icon in the top header — both are available on every page and your choice is remembered.

banksVsWallets.q: What's the difference between a bank and a wallet?
banksVsWallets.a: Banks require a SWIFT/BIC code, wallets don't. Add either from the Banks & Wallets page and pick the right type — this affects what payment and change options appear in the order form.
